title: Localization preserves the specified strict structural evaluation
statement: Fix l,E,W, a model M, and Good strict input complexes N [stage3-pur-integral-realization-data]. Let e_P be the recursively constructed systemComparison of [stage3-pur-integral-expression-system-comparison]. For every StructuralMap alpha:P->Q [def-pur-completed-operation-comparison-data], localization of the actual strict cochain structuralValue(alpha) obeys Q(alpha).hom ; e_Q.hom = e_P.hom ; systemStructuralValue(alpha).hom. The strict maps are the actual cochain reassociator, scalar unitors, signed symmetry and prescribed adjunction-normalized inverse-image compositor, with inverses, composites and tensor/pullback contexts. This assertion involves no completion or quotient-presentation construction.

proof.text: The tensor-generator extensionality principle identifies the chain maps in M.system.symmetry_model and associator_model with the native signed braiding and reassociator: their values on every homogeneous pure tensor coincide. The unit_model formula identifies the right unitor, with all other unit summands zero. Symmetry and the right unit equation give the left unit equation. Naturality transports each factor comparison.

theorem structuralSystemComparison (M : CompletedOperations.Models l E W)
    {I : Type i} {location : I → S} (N : ∀ k : I, Complex l E (W (location k)))
    (hg : ∀ k : I, Good l E (W := W) (location k) (N k))
    {a : S} {P Q : CompletedOperations.Expression W location a}
    (α : CompletedOperations.StructuralMap P Q) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (structuralValue l E N α).hom ≫
        (systemComparison l E M N hg Q).hom =
      (systemComparison l E M N hg P).hom ≫
        (CompletedOperations.structuralValue l E M α
          (fun k ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N k))).hom
